Access to **wells, schools, temples**; schools, hostels, cooperatives; **inter-dining, inter-caste marriage**

0.x: **Harijan tour: November 1933 – July 1934**, about **20,000 km**, starting from **Wardha**; funds for the Sangh; orthodox groups disrupted his meetings.

Untouchability = "**a blot on Hinduism**"; removal **from within Hindu society** by moral persuasion, temple entry, funds, schools, hostels and constructive work ("Hinduism dies if untouchability lives").
**"Harijan"** ("children of God") – term from the Gujarati saint **Narsi Mehta**; **Ambedkar** and Dalit leaders **rejected the term**.
Post-1937 Congress ministries: **free education** and other upliftment for Harijans.
Founder = Gandhi; president = Birla; secretary = Thakkar Bapa.

r: **Craft-centred**, vocational; dignity of manual labour; education to be **self-supporting**
**Wardha (All-India National Education) Conference, October 1937** → scheme drawn up by the **Zakir Hussain Committee**; adopted at **Haripura (Feb 1938)**
**Free and compulsory**, **7 years (age 7-14)**; **mother tongue** medium; learning through a **productive craft**; self-sufficient villages
**Self-realisation** – growing into a **divine human being** by realising godliness, not acquisition or mere employment
**Socially Useful Productive Work (SUPW)** in the curriculum grew from **Gandhi's** idea of education through productive work

2.x: Opposed **purdah, child marriage, dowry**; **supported remarriage of child widows**. Gandhi's own concepts: satyagraha, sarvodaya, trusteeship, Nai Talim.
Women's role in satyagraha: **picketing liquor shops**, salt-making.
**Sarva dharma samabhava** – equal respect for all religions; **ashram prayers** drew on many faiths.
**Hindu-Muslim unity** = the bedrock of nationalism; he backed the **Khilafat**.
